bio: I'm a Senior Angular developer with 8+ years of commercial frontend experience, working with every Angular version from 5 to 21. I led two production upgrades: Angular 9 → 21 on a retail forecasting platform, and 8 → 16 on an employee-assessment CRM I built from scratch. I'm currently moving a sales CRM from RxJS to Signals. I've been the key frontend developer on long-running projects for US clients: mentoring, organising releases, estimates, and direct English communication with product owners and designers. I also work with React (middle level) and Vue (junior level). Remote, based in Kyiv region, Ukraine.
